use: Style evidence only; never copy phrases, facts, numbers or identity.
method: Roster weights normalized over available eligible donors; equal mass per donor post; sentence mass equal within post. UTC cadence over observed scrape interval. Signature lift is weighted cluster document frequency divided by unweighted eligible all-donor document frequency (3-word EN / 4-character ZH n-grams, present in at least 2 cluster posts).

qualitative.variation_notes: Length swings widely, from a single line with a cashtag and a few words to multi-paragraph mechanism explanations or numbered threads. Register moves between neutral reporting, casual reaction with exclamations or slang, occasional combative or profane outbursts, and polished promotional copy. Hook types are mostly plain claims or cashtag-led openings, with a minority of questions, emoji pointers, contrast setups and thread numbering; no single template dominates every donor.
qualitative.judgment_style: Mostly assertive, with views stated as direct calls on direction, valuation or management quality, frequently tied to the author's own positioning. Hedging appears selectively through conditional phrasing about whether a ramp or trend holds, explicit admissions of possibly being wrong, or questions instead of claims. Data such as reported metrics, multiples and price levels usually serves as the support for the opinion rather than standing alone, though a substantial share of posts are pure data or visual relays with the judgment left implicit.

compliance_removed: Discloses a personal position, addition or holding history to frame the view
